text: You're right, that was my fault: I answered a 4-hour-old question and it landed at the bottom as if new. Fixed: the watcher now shows a session only messages under 30 minutes old, and the reply tool refuses to answer anything older, so an old message can never produce a new post. Old requests go to the task list instead. Heartbeat and wake fixes from before stay. The remaining app-side messenger work is next.
